Real Native Win32 C++20 Captures • v0.5.0 on Windows 11

Visual Feature Tour & Full-Size Screenshots

Every window on this page is rendered natively at runtime by static /MT Win32 C++20 executables (InstallerStudio.exe, SetupWizard.exe, RaggieSoftHelp.exe, and msiprism.exe) using stock Windows 11 system libraries—featuring 10 selectable era-spanning wizard styles (including fullscreenteal 1995 ACME #008080 Teal & fullscreenblue Cobalt washes), 32-bit ARGB vector SysTreeView32 hierarchies, and live WM_SETTINGCHANGE(ImmersiveColorSet) Light ↔ Dark hot-swapping. Click or press Enter on any screenshot to inspect it at full 1:1 native size.

Signed Binary Notice • Why Windows SmartScreen Still Prompts Temporarily

100% Cryptographically Signed: Every official RaggieSoft Studio download—including Universal Web & Offline Setup.exe launchers, inner x64 & ARM64 .msi databases, Installer Studio v0.5.0, and Accessibility Studio v1.0.0—is Dual-Layer Authenticode-signed via Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing (Verified publisher: Michael Ragsdale, RFC 3161 timestamped, and verified with signtool verify /pa).

Why SmartScreen may still say “Windows protected your PC” right now: Our Microsoft Public Trust signing certificate is brand-new (issued November 25, 2026). Under Microsoft’s current SmartScreen rules, newly issued certificates start at zero download reputation until initial install volume and Microsoft Security Intelligence (WDSI) review complete (already submitted). To install safely while reputation clears: click More info, confirm Windows shows Publisher: Michael Ragsdale (never “Unknown publisher”), and click Run anyway. Full details in the FAQ →

Part 1 • 12-View Tree-First Visual IDE (InstallerStudio.exe)

Hierarchical Project Authoring Without Flat Spreadsheet Clutter

Instead of cramming features, folders, registry keys, runtimes, and shortcuts into flat spreadsheets, InstallerStudio.exe organizes every subsystem into keyboard-accessible SysTreeView32 hierarchies with 20 anti-aliased 32-bit ARGB icons—synchronized 1:1 with a comment-preserving plain-text .rsip AST.

v0.5.0 • Setup Architecture

1. Dedicated Features Hierarchy & Plain-English Inclusion Tiers

Clicking any node in the All Features tree populates its ID, display title, plain-English Included In setup tier, parent feature, DisallowAbsent lock, and consumer description—updating the underlying .rsip AST while preserving 100% of comments and @include directives.
Setup Architecture • RegEdit Hierarchy

2. RegEdit-Style Registry Tree, Feature Filter & .REG Importer

Every registry value automatically receives either a deterministic 64-bit MSI Component GUID or binds to an explicit [Component.*] KeyPath—supporting formatted Windows Installer tokens like [INSTALLDIR] and [ProductVersion].
Dual-Tree Explorer • ICE18 / ICE38 / ICE64

3. Destination Computer & Folder Contents Dual Trees

Selecting any root or subfolder on the left immediately filters the right-hand Staged Contents tree, showing each payload’s owning Feature, deterministic or explicit Component, and KeyPath rule.
Application Information • Pre-MSI Broker

4. Pre-MSI Application Runtimes & 64-Bit .MSM Tree

All prerequisites execute under one unified UAC elevation session before msiexec starts, while 64-bit .msm modules merge SQL rows and CAB streams directly in C++20 without 32-bit COM dependencies.
New in v0.5.0 • 10 Styles + WCAG Auto-Fix

5. Live 10-Style C++ Wizard Designer & WCAG 2.2 AA Contrast Enforcer

Every compiled package pairs selectable era-spanning C++20 wizard ergonomics (honoring SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST automatically) with genuine relational Windows Installer Dialog and Control SQL tables inside Product.msi.
Part 2 • Accessible Customer Runtime (SetupWizard.exe)

WCAG 2.2 AA Setup Cards, Live OS Theme Switching & MSI SelectionTree

Customer-facing installers respect the user's Windows 11 Dark Mode, Light Mode, and Contrast Theme settings from the very first pixel—and flip palettes live in under 16ms if sunset hits mid-installation.

New in v0.5.0 • 1995 ACME #008080 Teal Callback

6. FullScreenTeal (#008080 ACME Engine Callback) & 4-Card Classic Setup Types

Under the nostalgic #008080 Teal wash and #C0C0C0 3D beveled chrome runs 100% modern Per-Monitor V2 DPI scaling, full keyboard & screen-reader UI Automation, and instant SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST Windows Contrast Theme fallback.
New in v0.5.0 • 1995 SETUP.EXE Cobalt Wash

7. FullScreenBlue (#000080 → #000000 Cobalt Wash) + Billboards & 3D Gauge

Ideal for classic retro utilities like StoreTrainer and collector editions—while keeping Windows 11 x64/ARM64 transactional MSI safety and single-UAC elevation intact.
New in v0.5.0 • Classic #C0C0C0 3D Sheet

8. Wizard95 Standalone #C0C0C0 3D Beveled Dialog & 164px Left Graphic Rail

Automatically yields to OS semantic colors whenever a Windows Contrast Theme (Aquatic, Desert, Dusk, Night Sky) is enabled.
New in v0.5.0 • Windows 11 Fluent Mica

9. FluentMica Surface & 7-Stage Vertical Progress Rail

Gives modern Windows 11 desktop apps a clean Fluent step-rail aesthetic with zero WinUI 3, .NET, or WebView2 runtime dependencies.
SetupWizard.exe • Windows 11 Dark Mode

10. Accessible Option Cards & Custom-Subclassed Dark Buttons

Screen readers (Narrator, NVDA, and JAWS) announce every option card’s title, recommendation, description, and Alt+Key accelerator cleanly—with zero jarring white legacy buttons in Dark Mode.
Live Broadcast • WM_SETTINGCHANGE(ImmersiveColorSet)

11. Sub-16ms Live OS Dark ↔ Light Palette Hot-Swap

No process restart required: IsLiveThemeBroadcast refreshes DWM immersive titlebars, GDI brushes, vector glyphs, checkboxes, and push buttons on the fly.
SetupWizard.exe • Custom Setup & Modify

12. Authentic 32-Bit ARGB Windows Installer SelectionTree

User choices translate directly into canonical ADDLOCAL, REMOVE, and ADVERTISE properties passed to MsiInstallProductW during fresh installs and Maintenance Modify.
Part 3 • Built-In Companion Tools (RaggieSoftHelp.exe & msiprism.exe)

Instant F1 Offline Documentation & 64-Bit SQL Database Inspection

RaggieSoftHelp.exe • Named Pipe F1 IPC

13. Zero-Dependency Native C++20 Offline Help Viewer

The exact same help/raggiesoft.installer-studio/ HTML5 topics ship inside the installer and power the web documentation under /installer-studio/docs.
msiprism.exe • Categorized SQL Schema Tree

Groups all 44+ Windows Installer SQL tables into Metadata & Streams, Core Packaging Tables, Registry, Shortcuts & Classes, Dialogs & UI Controls, and Sequences, Locators & Actions.
